topic: Bare role NPs outside predicative complement
claim: Treasurer in I was elected treasurer is a bare role NP restricted to the function of predicative complement.
evidence_summary: Page 409 lists complement of of after role, part or position, with [19iii] The role of treasurer will fall to Henry. Page 1358 has the supplement Wilson, Secretary to the Cabinet. Ch. 4 p. 255 treats the as phrase as a marked predicative, which covers [19ii] only.
finding: Extend the restriction to the of construction and supplements, or explain how they count as predicative. CG-0024 concerns insertion of the in the same NPs.
proposed_wording: Bare role NPs are restricted to predicative functions, the complement of of after nouns such as role, and supplements.
inference: Can a determiner-less role NP occur only as predicative complement?

evidence.passage: §8.2, p. 401 [5iv]. “a bare role NP restricted to the function of predicative complement”.
evidence.example: Page 409 [19iii] The role of treasurer will fall to Henry. Page 1358, Wilson, Secretary to the Cabinet.
evidence.establishes: The chapter’s own inventory includes a non-predicative function.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
